mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance becomes accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction that depresses corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) signals overheating that triggers Fed policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.5%) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 5.0% (computed from CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive Fed tightening, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal weakening labor demand and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% and sustained), higher discount rates compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles.
